module: Handler for the 'hubWheelsTSI' wheel type: a variant of hubWheels without hubcap. Ring of tire nodes + ring of hub nodes, tread, periphery, hub and axle beams, and six pressurized beams per ray between hub and tire (air pressure is simulated). Called by jbeam/sections/wheels.lua during vehicle loading.
usage: -- called by the dispatcher: process(vehicle, wheelKey, wheel)
notes: Differences from hubWheels: no hubcap, no V beams nor tread reinforcements; if tireWidth or hubWidth are not provided, they are set to the node1-node2 distance in the wheel table (wheel.tireWidth, wheel.hubWidth). The hub* hub options are applied only if they are defined (no 'or').

Pressurized beams of type BEAM_PRESSURED (3) based on the reinforcement options (wheelReinforcementBeam*) with pressurePSI (default 30), volumeCoef = 1/(numRays*6), surface computed from radius, hubRadius, tireWidth, hubWidth; reinforcementPressure* (PSI, Spring, Damp) for the reinforcements.
The tire nodes are linked by pairedNode (inner -> outer -> next inner). BEAM_SUPPORT (7) support beams if enableTireSideSupportBeams.

Result: wheel.nodes = hub nodes, wheel.pressuredBeams = pressurized beams. Default parameters: radius 0.5, hubRadius 0.65*radius, numRays 10, treadCoef 1. wheel.collision forced to true. C constants: NORMALTYPE 0, BEAM_ANISOTROPIC 1, BEAM_PRESSURED 3, BEAM_SUPPORT 7.
TSI/TSV: acronyms not explained in the code (inferred: 'pressure' and 'vertical' variants of the same construction; to be confirmed on the editor side).

process.desc: Creates nodes and beams of a hubWheelsTSI wheel (alias of addHubWheelTSI). Warning 'invalid hubWheel' and exits without creating anything if node1 or node2 cannot be found.

wheelKey.desc: index of the wheel in its section

wheel.desc: jbeam definition of the wheel (modified: collision, radius, hubRadius, numRays, tireWidth, hubWidth, nodes, pressuredBeams)
